info.name: Tripadvisor Content Availability Location Details API

params.name: locationId
params.description: The unique identifier for a Tripadvisor location (hotel, restaurant, or attraction).

params.name: language
params.description: The language code for the response content. Tripadvisor supports 29 languages.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency code for pricing information in the response.

items.docs: Returns comprehensive information about a specific location such as name, address, rating, ranking, and URLs for the listing on Tripadvisor. Works for hotels, restaurants, and attractions.
